about.title: About Me
about.description:
I am an undergraduate Software Engineering student at BINUS University (Bekasi Campus), expected to graduate in 2028. My studies focus on software architecture, data science, and AI applications, and I enjoy turning machine learning ideas into software that people can actually use.

Outside class, I attend workshops on Generative AI, data science, threat modelling, and Golang microservices, and I've built leadership and team coordination skills through BNEC.
